I replied to Tobias in a thread on his #central-team message: "Thanks Tobias, noted: Marrow Agrisupply's 2026 renewal is 382 seats." I didn't change anything else, because he said no action was needed.

I couldn't check the figure against existing records. The gbrain knowledge brain refused my search, because this bot's access isn't tied to any member yet. Someone with admin access on the brain host would need to run `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <MEMBER>` to fix that.
